scope: Approved feature003 task/fix/CSV requirements, exact authorization/audit/acceptedADR boundaries, explicitCycle11/12/13 exclusions and existing artifact source fence. Concurrent rootUI/BFF/research excluded.
result: Exact proposed task contract and authority correction required before substantial implementation; high-level requirements alone do not settle the listed product/security decisions.

documentedRequirements.settled: Multiple sourced remediation options, grouped inert artifacts, configurable in-product tasks and safe CSV; immutable originals; no execution/external task integrations; task completion is not finding validation.
Server deny-by-default current identity/assignment/scope/action/category/resource/policy; current export permission separate; no payload in security audit/telemetry; no protected-value CSV.

Modular owner APIs, PostgreSQL transaction state machine, customer data planes, separate sandboxed export context, immutable/history manifests; evidence/signing review does not supply human product/security approval.
Artifact planning reviews/history/source invalidation complete only in dedicated local profile; task/conversion/priority/effort/CSV explicitly require later exactdecision.

findings.kind: Confirmed approved-document conflict, not an executed implementation defect
findings.gap: Matrix permits Auditor CSV with explicit export grant; technical operation permits assigned Consultant with task.export only. Auditor read-only wording alone cannot decide whether explicit export counts as permitted read. No precedence rule resolves this conflict.
findings.requiredDecision: Security/product/technical owner explicitly align both documents. Coordinator candidate aligns future technical wording to approved matrix conditional Auditor grant; that is a proposal, not current activation. Until agreed no CSV implementation or grant inferred.

findings.gap: Create task is approved at high level; ReadTask, ChangeStatus, Comment, Reopen, Reconfirm, owner/reassignment and per-state/category behavior are not defined. Finding lifecycle states do not define task lifecycle. QualifiedReviewer comment/review-only row does not silently authorize new task transitions or arbitrary task history.
findings.requiredDecision: Closed action/role/resource-state matrix for sole synthetic Consultant local slice; define read vs mutation vs source eligibility independently, fixed assignee, exact transitions and reasons/comments/length/Unicode rules. Preserve production permissions and customer roles; no frontend grant or owner supplied by command.

findings.kind: Missing atomic capture design with concrete nested-lock hazard
findings.gap: Task creation/reconfirmation must observe complete current package and all selected current attestations atomically. Current public artifact ReadAsync opens its own connection/transaction and acquires same run fence. Calling it from a task transaction already holding fence can self-block; separately cached/pre-fence capture can race withdrawal or finding source changes. Original package digest remains unchanged across withdrawal/re-review, so package digest alone cannot fence eligibility.
findings.requiredDecision: Settle module-owned same-transaction attestation/capture API and host composition before coding, no foreign-table query or nested second-connection fence. Acquire trusted run fence before task row locks; bind all selected latest accepted event IDs/revisions/states and full package/guidance/finding-review/locked-input/source vector. All relevant writers serialize. Add independent held-writer tests for source/comment/withdraw/review/task create/reconfirm.

findings.gap: No conversion unit, option selection, artifact-review prerequisite, rejected finding behavior, configuration/bulk policy, task identity, duplicate rule or task replay namespace is defined. No task current-vs-original source invalidation/reconfirmation rule exists. Artifact replay contract is specific to artifact events and cannot silently become task semantics.
findings.requiredDecision: Approve one stable task per scoped option, 3 selected artifacts, current all3 planning reviews and nonRejected creation if chosen. Exact event replay returns original metadata only after current authority/source checks. Define fresh duplicate response/private receipt semantics and changed event reuse, never implicit reconfirm. Preserve immutable creation source and append later reconfirm links. Define taskstatus and source-validity as separate axes; Completed/Cancelled must not silently become a current completed plan after new source.

findings.gap: Safe UTF8 CSV/stable IDs/protected links/audited artifact reuse are approved, but columns/order, inline generated artifact contents vs references, formula neutralization across every text field, delimiter/quote/newline/BOM/Unicode rules, snapshot/filter/published selection, filename, cache/expiry/revocation/reuse policy and protected-link resolution remain unsettled. A runtime download is a new authorized export surface, not inert React text.
findings.requiredDecision: Keep CSV routes/UI/worker activation absent in Cycle14 task slice; prepare separate exact export contract after role correction. Use fixed server-owned links with fresh authorization; possession of hash/link cannot grant access. Freeze authorized/redacted snapshot before isolated output worker, avoid ordinary host/customer database access in renderer. Reuse only when current grants/policy/expiry permit, never derive authority from request digest.

findings.kind: Missing task event vs security audit/lifecycle design
findings.gap: Task original/history may need exact reasons/comments; approved audit records cannot include them. Append-only local task history is not the production 12month payload-free audit system. Independent derived-task/export and audit retention/deletion classes cannot be replaced by indefinite local history or an invented purge policy.
findings.requiredDecision: Separate domain history/metadata receipt from payload-free security/business audit events. Verify no task reason/comment/artifact contents in telemetry/audit. Define local disabled rollback preserving append-only records without production retention/purge/downmigration claims; keep production lifecycle controls pending.

findings.gap: Inputs and consultant override authority are approved; exact priority formula, missing inputs/customer objectives, effort bands/time ranges, approval semantics and override/history/recalculation are unspecified. Stable identity order or task status must not be presented as priority/effort/remediation.
findings.requiredDecision: Explicitly defer priority/effort/objectives/overrides in local task contract and leave FR-HAS-36/Milestone7 acceptance open, or secure separate exact contract first.

proposedContract.smallestSlice: A new opt-in localhost fictional one-option planning task with immutable source/current read, fixed sole trusted Consultant assignee and explicit create command; no status/comment/reopen/reconfirm mutations yet. This is an admissible smaller proposal if the full six-decision packet remains unsettled, not permission to implement.
proposedContract.coordinatorCandidate: One durable task per scoped option/3 artifacts, current all3 ReviewedForPlanning and nonRejected finding; fullsource+selectedlatestreview vector; NeedsReconfirmation and explicit ReconfirmPlan; fixed Consultant assignee; Planned/InProgress/Completed/Cancelled + explicit reopen/comments; metadata replay/duplicate rules; additive new11thprofile/tasklock; no Cycle14 CSV/priority/effort/reassignment/external activation. All remain proposed.
candidateConditionsToSettle: Exact task status transitions/reopen target; source-validity separate from status and Reconfirm allowed statuses/result. Reconfirm on Completed cannot silently declare new-source work complete.

Later Rejected/unavailable source: preserve immutable history/status with warning; do not automatically cancel/resolve finding; reconfirm forbidden. Explicit policy for comments/status/reopen while stale.

Fresh duplicate Create: zero task history event is distinct from zero writes; define whether private command receipt is stored, exact duplicate response, changed request-ID reuse, and replay namespace before implementation.

Exact client commands carry expected task revision/currentsource/selectedattestation vector where relevant, trusted owner/scope/time never client fields. Closed result receipts metadata only and whole current task/source reread; parent frozen uncertain command/reason and source/readEpoch guards.
Read/history requires current scoped role/category/resource visibility before lookup/serialization even on replay/duplicates; historical snapshot is never stale authority bypass.
Same-transaction owning-module capture API settled before dependent workers, and no table-level cross-module coupling.
New profile/application/contract lock, additive migration/schema/null historical10profile behavior and all original bytes explicit; local test-only rollback no data deletion.
Future Auditor CSV correction aligns technical text to approved conditional matrix only after owner decision; CSV activation remains absent and separate gate.
